{{Top|leg}}
A '''comnet''' was a communications network that could be accessed via [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. It allowed communication between individuals. [[Slicer/Legends|Slicers]] could open temporary locations on the comnet for individuals to talk in a more private setting.
